turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your week going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My boyfriend just started cycling and he's way slower than me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ah, mismatched pace. Would you enjoy slower rides together, or would you rather do your own fast rides and meet up for some easy ones?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, Maya just called my name. Please wait and stay silent until I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm here every Thursday if you want to join the run.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe next week, my knee's sore.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maya, did you move my pump? It was right here by the shoe rack.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The silver one? I used it this morning, it's in my room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you grab it? My front tire is basically flat.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hold on. Here. Oh, and the head is a bit loose, you have to push it on hard.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. Thanks.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Are you riding to the market?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, want anything?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Bread, if they still have the seeded one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm back with you.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. About riding with your boyfriend, together or separate?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Separate fast rides, plus one easy ride a week together.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great balance. You get your training, and he doesn't feel rushed.
